clock.rule: theta_{k+1} = theta_k + omega_ticks(k); theta = 2 pi theta_ticks / 1280

stage_key.W1_W2: per ring s = k - (k0 + 2 ring). W1 forward: s<0 glyph; 0 squashed glyph; 1 dash at glyph arc; 2 radial slide (t=0.5); 3 dashes on the ring circle (60 % arc); 4 dashes closing (80 % of gaps); >=5 closed grooved ring. W2 reverse: s<0 ring; 0 dashes 80 %; 1 dashes 60 %; 2 slide; 3 dash at T2 glyph arc; 4 squashed glyph; >=5 glyph.
stage_key.W3: per key ring m s = k - (k0 + 2 m); each run swaps at s = 0 (first half of the ring's runs in token order) or s = 1 (second half): glyphs -> one real key of the run's arc at the run's place (2 frames) -> slide to its slot (3 frames) -> home.
